newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan machinery orders on rising trend--EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan machinery orders on rising trend--EPA.

text.p: Japan's machinery orders are on a rising trend overall, an Economic Planning Agency (EPA) official said on Thursday.
The agency's assessment was a slight improvement from the judgment it gave the previous month.

The EPA announced earlier that Japan's private-sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell a seasonally adjusted 9.7 percent in November from the previous month.

The official said machinery orders for the October to December period were expected to meet the official estimate of a 19.3 percent rise from the previous quarter and exceeding the April-June rise of 10.8 percent.
